evidence_quotes: de staatssecretaris van Justitie en Veiligheid bepaald dat op 4 september 2023 het recht op bescherming eindigt dat de vreemdeling geniet op grond van Richtlijn 2001/55/EG
rationale: This Dutch Raad van State decision concerns immigration and temporary protection law (termination of temporary protection for a foreign national under EU Directive 2001/55/EC and Implementing Decision (EU) 2022/382 by the State Secretary for Justice and Security), with no connection to water law, water infrastructure, or sanitation governance.
